The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to brew [[a mug of beer|mugs of beer]] and [[a mug of mead|mugs of mead]]. The blueprints for the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} will become accessible after unlocking [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Brewing]] in the Farming and nature technology tree.
